title: Coder issue runs on CoderOS die with "owner process ended"
body: Two issue flows on CoderOS (#10189, #10181; runner binaries built from feb4bc8270 in ~/coder-runner, run via `chat work` from ~/openagents) failed with "Coder stopped before finishing: owner process ended. Nothing was pushed". Suspects: the host's idle restart (SIGUSR1 re-exec) or a binary replacement during the run killing or orphaning the detached `microcoder issue-flow` owner; the new per-task store (f99d5973b8) migration during the batch; OOM. Find the cause from the task records under ~/.openagents/tasks/task/ and the journal on coderos-4080, fix it so a detached owner survives host restarts and binary replacement (re-exec-safe paths, like #10228), and add a regression test.
